fix.note: 把聲 = someone's voice; 講聲 = let someone know; 大聲 = loud.

ex.r: nei5 baa2 seng1 hou2 saa1 aa3 mou5 si6 maa3
ex.en: Your voice is so hoarse, are you okay?

ex.r: gaak3 lei4 hou2 daai6 seng1 aa3
ex.en: The neighbors are so loud.

ex.r: dou3 zo2 zau6 gong2 seng1 laa1
ex.en: Let me know when you get there.

fix.note: 加人工 = get a raise; 出糧 = get paid.

ex.r: ni1 fan6 gung1 jan4 gung1 gei2 do1 aa3
ex.en: What's the salary for this job?

ex.r: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 gaa1 jan4 gung1
ex.en: I'm getting a raise next month.

ex.s: 佢轉咗工，人工高咗好多。
ex.r: keoi5 zyun3 zo2 gung1 jan4 gung1 gou1 zo2 hou2 do1
ex.en: She changed jobs and her salary went up a lot.

ex.r: lau4 di1 sung3 bei2 aa3 baa1 laa1
ex.en: Save some food for Dad.

ex.r: nei5 lau4 faan1 zoeng1 daan1 laa1
ex.en: Keep the receipt.

ex.r: ngo5 soeng2 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 lau4 do1 gei2 jat6
ex.en: I want to stay in Hong Kong a few more days.

fix.note: 有冇咩介紹？ = what do you recommend?

ex.r: ngo5 gaai3 siu6 ngo5 lou5 po4 bei2 nei5 sik1
ex.en: Let me introduce my wife to you.

ex.r: keoi5 gaai3 siu6 zo2 fan6 gung1 bei2 ngo5
ex.en: She referred me for a job.

ex.s: 你可唔可以介紹間好餐廳？
ex.r: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 gaai3 siu6 gaan1 hou2 caan1 teng1
ex.en: Can you recommend a good restaurant?

fix.en: to laugh; to smile; to laugh at

ex.s: 佢睇住手機笑到停唔到。
ex.r: keoi5 tai2 zyu6 sau2 gei1 siu3 dou3 ting4 m4 dou2
ex.en: She can't stop laughing at her phone.

ex.r: m4 hou2 siu3 ngo5 laa1
ex.en: Don't laugh at me!

ex.r: jing2 soeng2 siu3 haa5 laa1
ex.en: Photo time, smile!

fix.note: Often 除咗…之外. With 都 = except; with 仲 = besides.

ex.r: ceoi4 zo2 ngo5 go3 go3 dou1 heoi3
ex.en: Everyone's going except me.

ex.r: ceoi4 zo2 jyun4 seoi1 ngo5 mat1 dou1 sik6
ex.en: I eat everything except cilantro.

ex.s: 除咗中文，佢仲識講日文。
ex.r: ceoi4 zo2 zung1 man2 keoi5 zung6 sik1 gong2 jat6 man2
ex.en: Besides Chinese, she also speaks Japanese.

fix.note: 出街 = go out. Measure word 條.

ex.r: ni1 tiu4 gaai1 jau5 hou2 do1 siu2 sik6
ex.en: This street has lots of snacks.

ex.r: je6 maan5 tiu4 gaai1 hou2 zing6
ex.en: The street is quiet at night.

ex.r: gwo3 gaai1 jiu3 tai2 ce1 aa3
ex.en: Watch for cars when you cross the street.

fix.note: Saying it to someone directly can be rude.

ex.r: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 fei4 zo2
ex.en: I've gained weight lately.

ex.r: nei5 zek3 maau1 hou2 fei4 aa3
ex.en: Your cat is so fat!

ex.r: ni1 faai3 juk6 taai3 fei4 laa3
ex.en: This piece of meat is too fatty.

fix.note: Also used casually to address a shop owner or waiter.

ex.r: ngo5 lou5 sai3 gam1 jat6 m4 hai2 dou6
ex.en: My boss isn't in today.

ex.r: gaan1 pou3 ge3 lou5 sai3 hou2 hou2 jan4
ex.en: The shop owner is really nice.

ex.r: lou5 sai3 maai4 daan1
ex.en: Boss, the check please!

fix.note: Borrow from = 問…借; lend to = 借…俾.

ex.s: 可唔可以借支筆嚟用吓？
ex.r: ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 ze3 zi1 bat1 lai4 jung6 haa5
ex.en: Can I borrow a pen?

ex.r: ngo5 soeng2 man6 ngan4 hong4 ze3 cin2 maai5 lau2
ex.en: I want to borrow money from the bank to buy a flat.

ex.r: ngo5 ze3 zo2 bun2 syu1 bei2 keoi5
ex.en: I lent him a book.

fix.en: to give (a gift); to see off, take

ex.r: ngo5 sung3 zo2 tiu4 geng2 gan1 bei2 keoi5
ex.en: I gave her a scarf as a gift.

ex.r: maai5 loeng5 go3 sung3 jat1 go3
ex.en: Buy two, get one free.

ex.r: ngo5 sung3 nei5 faan1 uk1 kei2 laa1
ex.en: I'll take you home.

fix.en: to fall; to drop; to lose (something)

ex.r: siu2 sam1 di1 m4 hou2 dit3 can1
ex.en: Be careful, don't fall.

ex.r: di1 lau4 gaa3 dit3 zo2
ex.en: Property prices have dropped.

ex.r: ngo5 dit3 zo2 ngan4 baau1
ex.en: I lost my wallet.

ex.r: ni1 go3 wing6 ci4 hou2 sam1
ex.en: This pool is really deep.

ex.r: ni1 go3 wun2 hou2 sam1 ho2 ji5 zong1 tong1
ex.en: This bowl is deep, you can use it for soup.

ex.r: ni1 bun2 syu1 hou2 sam1 ngo5 tai2 m4 ming4

fix.en: to clap; to pat; 拍拖 = to date
fix.note: Also = to film: 拍片, 拍戲.

ex.r: daai6 gaa1 jat1 cai4 paak3 sau2
ex.en: Everyone, clap together!

ex.r: keoi5 paak3 paak3 ngo5 bok3 tau4
ex.en: He patted me on the shoulder.

ex.r: keoi5 dei6 paak3 zo2 saam1 nin4 to1 laa3
ex.en: They've been dating for three years.

fix.en: to save (up); to collect; to store
fix.note: Spoken cou5; dictionary reading cyu5. Also = collect: 儲郵票.

ex.r: ngo5 cou5 gan2 cin2 heoi3 leoi5 hang4
ex.en: I'm saving money for a trip.

ex.r: ngo5 mui5 go3 jyut6 cou5 loeng5 cin1 man1
ex.en: I save 2,000 dollars a month.

ex.r: bou6 sau2 gei1 mou5 wai2 cou5 soeng2 laa3
ex.en: My phone has no space left for photos.

fix.note: Measure word 條. 識路 = know the way.

ex.r: ni1 tiu4 lou6 hou2 sak1 ce1
ex.en: The traffic on this road is really bad.

ex.r: ngo5 m4 sik1 lou6 nei5 daai3 ngo5 heoi3 laa1
ex.en: I don't know the way, take me there.

ex.r: lok6 jyu5 lou6 waat6 siu2 sam1 di1
ex.en: The roads are slippery in the rain, be careful.

ex.r: ngo5 ting1 jat6 haau2 si5
ex.en: I have an exam tomorrow.

ex.r: haau2 si5 cin4 jat1 maan5 ngo5 fan3 m4 zoek6
ex.en: I couldn't sleep the night before the exam.

ex.r: ngo5 jiu3 haau2 si5 sin1 ho2 ji5 sing1 zik1
ex.en: I have to take an exam before I can be promoted.

ex.r: bou6 laang5 hei3 gei1 waai6 zo2
ex.en: The air conditioner broke.

ex.r: ngo5 baa2 ze1 waai6 zo2 ze3 baa2 bei2 ngo5 dak1 m4 dak1
ex.en: My umbrella broke, can you lend me one?

ex.r: di1 ngau4 naai5 waai6 zo2 m4 hou2 jam2

fix.en: to jump; 跳舞 = to dance

ex.r: keoi5 hoi1 sam1 dou3 tiu3 hei2 san1
ex.en: She jumped up with joy.

ex.r: zek3 gau2 tiu3 zo2 soeng5 cong4
ex.en: The dog jumped onto the bed.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 tiu3 mou5 laa1
ex.en: Let's go dancing!

notes: Mostly sense-order fixes (secondary meanings moved to 3rd example), a few unidiomatic sentences (出咗人工, 留喺香港多幾日, 拍咗拖三年), two translation precision fixes. Jyutping all verified; no drops.
